latest_snapshot.decision: partial expression index rankings_snapshot_latest_idx ON ((COALESCE(payload->>'surface','')), (COALESCE(payload->>'created_at','')) DESC, updated_at DESC) WHERE left(record_id,18)='ranking-snapshot::'. Created idempotently (IF NOT EXISTS, advisory lock) by RankingWriteStore bootstrap, same pattern as the existing count/family-keep indexes; additive, no data change.
latest_snapshot.why_not_updated_at_ordering: created_at is a caller-supplied payload field (snapshot_record(created_at=...)), so equality with updated_at (insertion time) cannot be proven in general, only observed at one measurement time. The SQL keeps ORDER BY created_at DESC, updated_at DESC exactly, so results are identical by construction; the index only makes it cheap.
latest_snapshot.scope_note: query now also restricts to the ranking-snapshot:: prefix (the only id snapshots are written under; hosted: every snapshot row has it). Without the index the query returns the same rows, only slower; no-surface (surface=None) calls are not index-served and remain a bounded prefix scan.
